queries.prompt: Design our platform stateful data and caching layer in ap-south-1 combining ElastiCache for Valkey, Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 with RDS Proxy, and DynamoDB.
Configure non-superuser guardrails (`--privilege_check enforce`), `ManageMasterUserPassword: true`, and `maxmemory-policy` alarms across our Aurora and ElastiCache Valkey platform modules.
Compare Amazon DynamoDB, ElastiCache for Valkey, MemoryDB for Valkey, and ElastiCache for Memcached for our platform golden paths across dev/qa and prod tiers.

Our microservices use a Redis cache for distributed locks and rate-limiting counters, and keys are randomly getting evicted under memory pressure and breaking locks. Which engine and parameter group policy should we enforce?

120 Lambda concurrency bursts keep exhausting our Postgres `max_connections` in production and someone hardcoded the master password in CloudFormation. How should our platform layer pool connections and manage credentials?
Why is a new GSI with `ProjectionType: ALL` throttling `PutItem` writes on our main DynamoDB table even when table WCU utilization looks low?
Before enabling `mcp.data-extensions.json` for our developer platform, what `schema.json` regex check prevents CVE-2026-85654 and what flags lock down the Postgres diagnostic MCP server?
CloudWatch shows `EngineCPUUtilization` hitting 88% on shard 1 of our cache cluster while overall host CPU is 25%, and `SwapUsage` reached 75 MB. Help us tune our cache tier and alarms.
We want our developer squads to move off legacy Redis OSS onto Valkey 8.0 and adopt Aurora Blue/Green deployments for PG 16 upgrades—give us the platform guardrails.
Compare Amazon EFS General Purpose vs Max I/O and Amazon FSx for Lustre for shared POSIX file storage across Linux HPC instances.
Our Application Load Balancer is returning HTTP 502 Bad Gateway errors because Node.js `keepAliveTimeout` is 5 seconds while ALB `idle_timeout` is 60 seconds.
Calculate our monthly EKS Extended Support control-plane surcharge across 6 Kubernetes clusters running deprecated 1.27 versions.
